description: Generate a ready-to-commit GitHub Actions workflow that gates a build on IA-QA: "eval_contract" runs a .ia-eval.yaml through ia-qa-com/eval-action@v1 (needs a provider key as a repo secret), "cli_checks" runs deterministic tools via npx @ia-qa/cli and fails the build on their verdict, "selector_drift" gates E2E selectors with @ia-qa/self-healing. Deterministic template, no LLM. Returns the YAML, the secrets to create and the next steps. Pair with generate_eval_yaml for the contract.

app_start_command.description: [selector_drift] Boots the app, e.g. "npm run start:ci". Never guessed: omitted, the step is a TODO.

fail_on_fail.description: Default true; false reports without gating.

gate.description: Default eval_contract. both = CLI checks + eval; all = CLI checks, drift, eval.

provider.description: Decides which repo secret is wired (default groq).

name: generate_ci_workflow
